ladder_definition.A_dense: per level, the minimum over dense candidates measured at that level on the eleven final seeds (kr-arccos1-d3 at all levels; ladder-retuned-tq at N=1000)

budget_fallback_applied: The frozen rule asks for the N=1000 winner at all five levels. ladder-retuned-tq costs ~180 s at N=1000 but is truncated (>1200 s) at N=10000 and ~320-900 s at the middle levels; with $7.36 of the $20 upper-envelope ledger left after two development rounds, it is measured at N=1000 only. This is the fallback clause of the frozen rule and is disclosed in the report.
